CATEGORY: 想 + V.; 叫/让 + V. (Grammar)
definition: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun. Control and modal-like verbs such as 叫/让 take a following action and do not take 了 in this use.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (3 distinct):
5 | 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.
1 | 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
1 | otherwise it means his mother didn’t want to go with his friend to the graveyard.

output.rule: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: 想 needs a following action (想 + V.); use 想让 + <person> + <V.> if the person is meant to do the action.

examples.explanation: 孟母一直想她的孩子受到良好的教育 → 孟母一直想让她的孩子受到良好的教育: 想 needs a following action, so use 想让 + person + V.
孟母想儿子开始打工可能减轻她的负担 → 孟母想让儿子开始打工可能减轻她的负担: 想 needs a following action, so use 想让 + person + V.
不想跟他的朋友去墓地 → 不想让他跟朋友去墓地: use 想让 + person + V.; otherwise, it means his mother did not want to go to the graveyard with his friend.
孟子的妈妈叫了孟子搬家 → 孟子的妈妈叫孟子搬家: 叫/让 is a modal verb here, so it takes no 了.

output.not_an_error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.
her_terms: 叫/让 is a modal verb
